source.description: Synthetic notes and plain-text search cases used to compare against the installed Obsidian desktop CLI. Contains no Obsidian application code.

scope: Unquoted literal terms joined by ASCII spaces, filename/content AND matching, merged context ranges, case folding, folder boundaries, ignored paths, file discovery, a single-match limit and total-before-limit. Excludes native advanced query operators and multi-match ordering under limits.
normalization: Sort files only; preserve context occurrence order and repeated entries.
Convert the native no-match text sentinel to an empty array.
